notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Rhythm and greeting
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] Shared rhythm can make strangers feel closer.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] A tapped beat is a tiny stand-in for a song.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Some say closeness comes first and the rhythm follows.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] Does a greeting need words at all?

notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Turn taking
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] Taking turns is one of the first things infants learn with others.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] The game counts beats, not feelings.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Turn taking can also be a ritual with no warmth in it.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] When does a habit become a bond?
